title: 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang
subtitle: Hai Yen T'ang, Hall of Peaceful Seas · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace, assumed: sizes from the texts and the ruin polygons, position from the plan or the ruin. Not a reading of the 1786 engravings yet.
rows: west block, two storeys, 11 bays on the west front (S109)
platform 1 m, eave 10 m, ridge 13 m above the ground

questions.title: What is S01: the original or the tracing?
海晏堂's east half and the plan's working names

evidence.title: Plate X: 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang, west, and the water clock
evidence.excerpt_other: Sur deux des côtés du triangle, sont placés douze animaux de différentes espèces, six de chaque côté.
evidence.summary: Ten bays with a central block and attic and end pavilions; a landing with two stairs, jets from vases along both ramps as at St Cloud and Versailles. A triangular basin; animals spout towards the centre; at the apex towards the building a rock group with a shell; the largest jet from a vase at the base; two pyramids at the sides. He says animals spout by hour count.

evidence.title: Plates XI to XIII: 海晏堂, other views
evidence.excerpt_other: Ce palais est rempli de jets d'eau, et son perron rappelle le palais de Caprarola, près de Viterbe en Italie.
evidence.summary: Weeping willows in the gardens of plate XI. Stair compared with Caprarola. Little else.

evidence.title: 玉明 侍游御園記 (in 蕉軒隨錄)
evidence.locator: 蕉軒隨錄, 御園侍游 (line 336 of the corpus file)
evidence.excerpt_zh: ◎御园侍游玉将军（明）有《侍游御园记》，成竹坪同年（林）曾属予代作跋语，恭书于后。按，《记》云：“咸丰六年秋七月二十一日，奉旨：本日散朝后，著玉明、肃顺自备鞍马，午初一刻进西南门，在山高水长伺候。有顷，上从内乘船，至山高水长后阁扇下船，出前门，谕玉明、肃顺暨珠勒亨、西拉布、托云、德勒格尔、伊勒东阿等脱去外褂。上乘马，命七臣随行。自山高水长游藻园，至厂地，过汇芳书院，复由紫碧山房至鱼跃鸢飞少坐。过蕊珠宫门，至黄花磴进茶毕，往西洋楼海宴堂，至转马台，过小角门，至狮子林清淑斋赏饭。左右四卓，命七臣坐，并奉温谕可饱食，非外边筵宴比也。上命膳房先给七臣面各一器，上进面，复进饭，颁赏御用菜蔬，七臣叩头谢。上进粥，复赏粥毕。随驾起行，由宝相寺、法慧寺、谐奇趣过明春门，至雷峰夕照马头，坐如在天上船，游福海。上命笔砚作诗毕，至渊氵亭镜澈马头下船。进丽春门骑马，由旧园东墙根过敷春堂，游西大堤汉城关，至含辉楼下马，命七臣散归。玉明自道光十一年由侍卫擢厕御前二十余年，仰邀优渥，得遍瞻御园盛景。欣感之余，谨作记以纪荣遇。”
evidence.summary: A rare first-hand record of a day in the garden four years before its destruction. The emperor takes seven officials by a named route from 山高水長 through 藻園, 彚芳書院, 紫碧山房 and 魚躍鳶飛, past 蕊珠宫門, on to 海宴堂 in the 西洋樓, a meal at 清淑齋 in 獅子林, 寳相寺, 法慧寺, 諧奇趣, by boat on 福海, then 敷春堂 and 含暉楼. All were standing then.

evidence.title: Engraving 10: 海晏堂 Haiyan Tang, west front and water clock
evidence.excerpt_other: There two broad staircases one swinging to the right and one to the left, met before the main entrance on the level of the second floor.
evidence.summary: Largest of the group; held Benoist's pumps and the main reservoir. Fifty small jets on the stair balustrades fed three basins. Twelve seated animal figures, one for each two-hour period, spouted in turn to a larger fountain in the pool. After Benoist's death the machinery failed and water was raised by buckets and ropes (Benoist 1786, Amiot 1787, per n.). Malone compares bronze figures in the Winter Palace, made later.

evidence.title: Engravings 11 to 13: 海晏堂 north, east and south
evidence.excerpt_other: The tallest parts of the building covered the hydraulic machines, and between them lay the reservoir.
evidence.summary: North front covers the machines, with the reservoir between; zigzag stairs at the east end lead to the reservoir; the south side repeats the north.

evidence.title: Informants on the ruins: Lu, Ho, Tung
evidence.excerpt_other: He says he was twelve sui, or ten or eleven years of age, and employed there as a helper to sweep the walks and pull the weeds, when the palace was destroyed in 1860.
evidence.summary: Old Lu lived in a hut at the east end of 海晏堂, the source of Malone's oral details on the European buildings. The eunuchs Ho and Tung, still there in 1919, told him what was rebuilt after 1860 and destroyed again in 1900. Treat as oral: useful, unverified.

evidence.title: 刘阳, 《圆明园的故事》, excerpt on 西洋楼, 澎湃
evidence.summary: 刘阳: 海晏堂, 1759, largest of the group; behind it the water tower, an H-plan solid building with a gallery below and balconies above, and a spiral stone stair on the east.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 西洋楼
evidence.summary: The editors walk the strip from west to east with completion dates and plaques: 谐奇趣 1751, 养雀笼 1759, then the fountains and the perspective walls, with their mechanical details. They put the whole at about 2% of the gardens.

evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部 none shown
evidence.summary: Plan of the Xiyang Lou waterworks across its dozen sites; the record shows no shelf number. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

evidence.title: 海晏堂东水车房
evidence.locator: 国家图书馆善本部 样094-4号

evidence.title: 海晏堂蓄水楼 加固, 北京青年报 via 人民网
evidence.summary: The surviving water tower of 海晏堂 is a rammed-earth core like an inverted truncated pyramid, about 7.2 m high. Conservation in 2016 propped the four corners with about 160,000 bricks and added a concealed drain on top.

evidence.title: 揭秘圆明园考古, 华西都市报 via 中证网
evidence.locator: news, 张中华 and 张利芳
evidence.summary: Three large campaigns since 1996 yielded over 50,000 finds. The campaign from 2012 dug 桃花洞, 大宫门, 养雀笼, the 海晏堂 water tower and 远瀛观. At 如园 Ru Yuan, the best-preserved of these sites and the first imitation of a Jiangnan garden dug here (19,000 m2 site, 2,800 m2 buildings, 3,800 m2 opened), diggers found 芝兰室, 云萝山馆, 听泉榭, 延清堂, 含碧楼, 挹霞亭, 观丰榭, 引胜轩, rockery, paths and shores, and burnt famille-rose floor tiles in 延清堂.

evidence.title: 西洋楼区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12205, free part
evidence.summary: Report's opening: the strip runs 860 m east-west, up to 300 m wide in the west and 65 m at its narrowest, about 70,000 m2, built 1747-1783. A central axis divides it into about five sections, each with its own north-south axis, thirteen units from 谐奇趣 to 线法墙. Survey results are paywalled.

evidence.title: 3D技术复现“万园之园”: 北京大学 stone scanning
evidence.summary: The park and Peking University's School of Archaeology and Museology record the carved stones by 3D scan, photogrammetry and panorama, at 大水法, 观水法, 远瀛观, 海晏堂 and pieces now on the Peking University campus. This is the nearest thing found to a 'Peking University Digital Yuanmingyuan'. It says over 10 sites have been dug since the 1990s.

evidence.title: Digital restoration research and 3D model of Xieqiqu, ISPRS Annals II-5/W3
evidence.summary: The Yuanmingyuan Digital Restoration Research Project of 2013 covered five of thirteen 西洋楼 scenes in its first two years: 谐奇趣, 海晏堂, 方外观, 蓄水楼, 观水法. The paper explains 谐奇趣's method: present-day survey with archival drawings and engravings.

evidence.title: [清华]观水法; [清华]海晏堂
evidence.summary: Link card to Tsinghua team renders of 观水法 Guan Shuifa. A sibling post covers 海晏堂, its page not seen.
